messages.subject: "lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite", found a corr > 1
parts:
Hi all,
I am not very good at understanding stats jargon so please go easy on me with the steps/walkthrough/acronyms. It is my first attempt at SEM modelling... 

So I conducted EFAs using a large sample, defined my constructs according to the emerging factors, and now am attempting a CFA to eplicate the EFA findings with another, even larger sample. This message is coming up
lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite;. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.

Looking at past messages in this group, I learned that I should be looking at my model's correlation matrix for potential correlations greater than 1. To me, this was nonsense and I couldn't understand how such a thing would even be possible. After finding how to pull up a correlation matrix on that CFA ('cor.lv" instead of "cov.lv), it was to my great surprise that, yes, there was a correlation greater than 1 in that grid (see attached photo, correlation ADMIRA with ATTITUDES).

Admiration was part of Attitudes in how I defined my constructs (along with Appreciate and Sympathy). See below for model:

bigmodel <- '
WARMTH =~ ST_FRIENDLY + ST_KIND + ST_WARM
INTELLIGENCE =~ ST_SMART + ST_SKILLFUL + ST_UNINTELLIGENTr
AUTOCOMPET =~ ST_INDEPENDENT + ST_ABLE + ST_COMPETENT
CONTACT =~ Contact3 + Contact4 + Contact5
OVERLAP =~ Overlap_me_oa + Overlap_ya_oa
ADMIRATION =~ Attitude2r + Attitude5 + Attitude20 + Attitude22r 
SYMPATHY =~ Attitude4 + Attitude21 + Attitude23
APPRECIATE =~ Attitude16 + Attitude17
ATTITUDES =~ ADMIRATION + SYMPATHY + APPRECIATE
STEREOTYPES =~ WARMTH + INTELLIGENCE + AUTOCOMPET
'
fit2 <- cfa(bigmodel, data=sampleDat)

Eventually, I want to get at the SEM model adding these relationships to the CFA (among other possibilities):
OVERLAP ~ CONTACT 
ATTITUDES ~ OVERLAP
STEREOTYPES ~ ATTITUDES

So I guess my questions are: What does that correlation mean in simple terms? (over 1? really?) What is causing this issue? What is the next step/what can I do to fix this, if anything is possible?

Thank you all for your time and consideration. Any help is appreciated at this point!
Jonathan C.

messages.subject: Re: "lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive definite", found a corr > 1
parts:
On 11/03/2013 07:01 AM, Jonathan Cadieux wrote:

> lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive
> definite;. use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.
>
> Looking at past messages in this group, I learned that I should be
> looking at my model's correlation matrix for potential correlations
> greater than 1.

It means that the two constructs (ADMIRA and ATTITUDES) are (almost)
indistinguishable, at least for your sample, using the indicators in
your model. My impression is that you have too many constructs: many of
them are highly (> 0.9) correlated.

The next step is to revise your CFA model, using fewer latent constructs.

Yves.
